'''Bal Ferensil''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who rose to the top ranks of [[Thaereian system|Thaereian]] politics following the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] sisters [[Aola Blen|Aola]] and [[Mala Blen]].
